fact: The ID4D diagnostic states that SIGA, in place since 2018, registers all life events and holds birth records from 1920 to 2010, that the ID database is separate from the civil registration database with integration still ongoing, and that the Leginon system gives other institutions controlled access to SIGA data, with interoperability still incipient.
title: Identification for Development (ID4D) Diagnostic: São Tomé e Príncipe
